Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Jr Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Jr Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Jr Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Postgraduate degree in Basic Science with NET, or a Graduate degree in a professional course with NET, or a Postgraduate degree in a professional course.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Jr Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs 37,000/- per month plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the IIT Delhi Jr Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to the specified address, with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Jr Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an online interview for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided for SC/ST candidates, which is 5%.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Jr Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Jr Research Fellow position at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based appointment for research purposes.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: The official notification and application details can be found on the IRD website of IIT Delhi, and the application is to be sent via email.
